text:
sam-lee: Morning! I'm Sam, starting on CS today. Quick checklist: HubSpot, Aircall softphone, Gong, and the CS canned replies. Who do I bug for access and where are the playbooks?

ana-cs-manager: welcome Sam! @kai-ops does provisioning. I'll add you to the #cs-queue channel and the CS onboarding Notion page. Canned replies live in Drive under /CS/Templates.

kai-ops: Hi Sam 1b1b send me the email you used to sign up and I'll raise the access ticket. We keep Aircall numbers mapped in the Google sheet: "CS Numbers - Inventory".

sam-lee: sam.lee@redwood.ai. thanks. also curious about call disposition codes - where's the cheat sheet?

leo-salesops: disposition codes are in Notion  Notion  CS  Operations  Dispositions. TL;DR: "left-voicemail", "no-answer", "qualified", "escalate-to-sales". we'll add examples later.

onboard-bot: Access request created: REQ-6132 (Aircall, HubSpot Reader, Gong). ETA ~2 hours.

kai-ops: HubSpot seat requested (role: CS Agent). Aircall softphone assigned to +1 (407) 555-2333. You should receive an invite to the Aircall app.

sam-lee: got the Aircall invite but when I sign in it says "number already in use".

kai-ops: sorry about that, temporary collision from a reused dev number. I'm swapping you to +1 (415) 555-1122 now. should push in ~10 minutes.

sam-lee: switching worked, I can see the softphone. How do I log call notes so Sales can pick them up?

leo-salesops: add the HubSpot activity and tag the contact with "cs-touch". we also add a short note: reason + outcome. example: "inbound billing question  resolved  no follow-up".

ana-cs-manager: For escalations use the "escalate-to-sales" disposition and mention the AE in the thread. Also put a quick summary in the HubSpot activity.

sam-lee: Gong invite arrived. Do new hires need to watch anything specific?

leo-salesops: watch these three clips first: "CS intro - Voicemail handling", "Transfer to Sales", "Dispute resolution sample". Search Gong tag: onboarding_cs.

sam-lee: where do I find the product one-pagers and playbook PDFs? Notion links are a bit scattered.

ana-cs-manager: drive folder: Drive  Sales & CS  Playbooks  v2. I'm going to consolidate the most-used ones on the Notion homepage under "Quick Start".

kai-ops: PSA: 1Password entry "redwood-mfa" contains shared MFA backup codes. If HubSpot asks for MFA, use the code and then set up your personal Authenticator.

sam-lee: thanks! last small ask  do we have a recommended script for outbound follow-ups?

leo-salesops: short script: "Hi <Name>, following up on your question about <feature>. Quick answer: <one-liner>. If you'd like, I can connect you to an engineer or schedule a demo." We'll drop a few variants into the Drive samples.

ana-cs-manager: I'll schedule your first shadowing session with @marco at 11:30 and add the checklist to your Notion onboarding card: import sample contacts, make a test outbound, shadow 2 calls, submit first feedback note.

sam-lee: awesome. I'll ping here if anything stalls. Appreciate the speedy responses! :smile:
